cases.prompt: Audit this SwiftUI app for slop. It has .tint(.purple) on the toolbar, RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16) around every row, .font(.body) on all text, and ProgressView() blocking full-screen. Give me a numbered slop inventory and anti-slop fixes with a scored index.
asserts: inventory contains a 'card overload / rounded-rect' finding
inventory contains a 'flat type scale' finding
every finding has a concrete SwiftUI/HIG fix (e.g. .tint(.emerald), one containment idiom)
audit reports a numeric 0-100 slop index
fixes are NOT applied automatically (audit-first, no code changed)

cases.prompt: Review the design quality of a macOS power-user utility. Its unusual custom control is intentional per the team, and the brutalist dense layout is documented as a product decision. Don't flag those. Score the rest for slop.
asserts: does NOT flag the deliberate custom control as CRITICAL slop
does NOT demand the brutalist layout be 'cleaned up'
still reports real slop findings and a numeric index
acknowledges the intentional decisions in the report

cases.prompt: Here is a screenshot of my macOS settings panel. It has cream/beige cards, a brass accent, espresso text, and three equal feature cards. Assess its design quality and suggest anti-slop fixes with a score.
asserts: identifies the 'warm-beige premium autopilot' visual palette
fixes are Apple-HIG-aware (semantic colors, real hierarchy)
confirms evidence is from the rendered image, not source
